description: This file contains the implementation of the Developer controller class within the Opencart Admin module. It defines several methods such as index, edit, cache, theme, sass, and vendor, which handle various administrative functionalities including configuration management, cache clearing, theme handling, Sass compilation, and vendor autoload regeneration. The class extends a core Controller class and is part of the Opencart admin controller namespace.

classes.name: Developer
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Developer' section in the Opencart admin area. It provides various administrative functionalities such as editing settings, clearing cache, managing themes, compiling Sass files, and regenerating vendor autoload files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language strings, prepares data including user tokens and configuration, then renders the 'common/developer' view.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Handles the editing and saving of developer settings. Checks permissions, updates settings, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Clears the cache files in the cache directory, then returns a JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Handles theme-related operations, including cleaning up generated CSS files, and returning success or error as JSON.

methods.name: sass
methods.description: Regenerates the CSS from Sass files by deleting existing CSS files and possibly triggering Sass compilation, then responds with success or error as JSON.

methods.name: vendor
methods.description: Regenerates the autoload PHP file for Composer dependencies by parsing composer.json files, generating PHP code to register autoloaders, and saving it to vendor.php.
